reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model SE4570, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The date code 07/22 NH is within the recalled date codes.
The purchase date of 2022-08-26 is before the sale window opening on 2022-09-01. Purchases before the window are not eligible.
The retailer (grainger.com) is on the list of sellers, so the denial rests on the purchase date alone.
No duplicate claims were found, so the claim is not flagged for review.
No destruction photo is required because the remedy is repair or replacement.
